channel_posts.rules:
🍊 **Welcome to the OrangeOrangus jungle!**
1. Respect everyone: no insults or discrimination.
2. No spam, flooding or self-promotion.
3. Staff will NEVER DM you first. No presale is open: be wary of anyone offering one.
4. Never share your seed phrase or private keys.
5. The only official links are the ones in #official-links.
6. No profit promises: OrangeOrangus is a community project, not financial advice.
Peel the hype. Release the ape. 🦧

channel_posts.scam-alerts:
🚨 **Scam alert: read this before anything else**
• Staff will NEVER DM you first. Anyone who does is an impostor.
• No presale is open and no token address has been published.
• Never share your seed phrase or private keys, with anyone, ever.
• Never "connect your wallet" to claim airdrops or rewards from links sent in DMs.
• Check every link against #official-links.
• Spotted something suspicious? Report it to a @Mod right away.

Stay safe, ape. 🦧
channel_posts.game-feedback:
🏎️ **OrangeOrangus Racing**
OrangeOrangus Racing is our arcade racing game, currently an early demo you can play in your desktop browser, no download needed. Mobile support is planned for a future update.
Play the demo: https://orangeorangus-racingdemo.netlify.app

It's a demo with virtual points only: no token rewards are live and none are promised.

👉 Tell us here: what you love, what's broken, what you'd add. Bugs, ideas and screenshots all help shape the game! 🦧
